Our office met with Mayor Madray & the Town Clerk of Jamestown. We discussed how our office can support the Town by connecting them with specific grant programs based on their needs for police officer equipment and technological improvements. 

Small towns like Jamestown deserve a seat at the table and we will always work to make sure they have the resources they need.

South Carolina STRONG.

South Carolina's Lowcountry is home to critical Marine and Naval assets. From Parris Island to MCAS Beaufort to Joint Base Charleston. Ensuring they have the funding and resources they need has and will always be a top priority.

South Carolina STRONG.

Video

South Carolina is the fastest growing state in the country and Charleston is one of its fastest growing cities. Investing in our infrastructure isn't optional, it's essential.

We supported a $140,000 grant through the U.S. Department of Transportation's Safe Streets and Roads for All Program (SS4A) for the City of Charleston.

While left-wing policies prioritize criminals over the safety of law-abiding Americans, we are working with @POTUS to restore law and order and make America's streets safe again.

Today, we introduced the No Bailouts for Cashless Bail Jurisdictions Act, legislation cutting off federal funding to any jurisdiction substantially eliminating cash bail as a condition of pretrial release for serious offenses.

The Save Our Shrimpers Act has officially PASSED the House and is now headed to the Senate for consideration. We were a lead cosponsor of this bipartisan legislation to ensure American tax dollars work for American shrimpers, not against them.

South Carolina's shrimping industry is part of our identity, our heritage, and our economy. For too long, our shrimpers have been undercut by foreign competitors bankrolled with American tax dollars.

INTRODUCING: The No Bailouts for Cashless Bail Jurisdictions Act.

Cashless bail policies are a direct threat to public safety. When you let violent criminals walk out of jail with no financial incentives to comply with the conditions of their release, communities pay the price. Taxpayers should not be funding jurisdictions refusing to keep dangerous people off the streets.

Iran was close to getting a nuclear weapon. President Trump has always said national security is number one. You cannot have peace in the Middle East with a nuclear Iran. 

Troops have not been put on the ground. A ceasefire is in place. The President is negotiating from a position of strength and he has been successful so far.

Video

Our office met with leadership from Charleston Water System to discuss the challenges they face. We covered PFAS regulations, how the Lowcountry's rapid growth and unique coastal geography strain the water system, and where our office can step in and deliver for them in Washington.

Clean water is not a political issue. It is a basic necessity. Every family in Charleston deserves to turn on the tap and know what comes out is safe.

South Carolina STRONG.

We supported a $212 MILLION investment awarded to the Coast Guard Base here in Charleston to completely rebuild their pier and deliver a brand new 30,000 square foot Medical and Dental Facility.

Thanks to the One Big Beautiful Bill Act which we supported, $25 billion was secured for the U.S. Coast Guard. Now $212 million is being invested right here in the Lowcountry.

This is a huge win for the men and women of USCG Base Charleston who work to keep our Lowcountry waters safe every single day.

Back in February, we wrote to the Central Intelligence Agency demanding access to all records related to Jeffrey Epstein and Ghislaine Maxwell after they refused to confirm or deny whether such records even exist, claiming the information itself is classified.

Nearly three months later, their response: "we have found no formal nor informal CIA relationship with Mr. Epstein."

We want to see for ourselves, not sit on our hands while agencies tell us the evidence doesn't exist. We're just suppose

Nearly a decade ago, Chicoba Crabtree, a disabled man dependent on a breathing tube, was brutally stabbed to death in his own home in Goose Creek, South Carolina. His final act was calling 911.

The suspect was found at the scene covered in blood. The evidence was there. The path to justice seemed clear.

Nine years later, she is still walking free on bond.

Nine. Years.

Eric Daugherty (@EricLDaugh)

🚨 NOW: The US Senate advances a resolution WITHHOLDING Senators' pay if the federal government shuts down, in a whopping 99-0 vote

This is LONG overdue! 👏🏻

Do not reward them for shutting down TSA, DHS, and withholding paychecks from federal workers!

National Police Week is a reminder of what we are working for every single day in Washington.

Republicans delivered $750 million in new resources for Federal Law Enforcement Training Centers through the Working Families Tax Cuts. Every single member on the Left voted no. While they voted against keeping our communities safe, we stood with our officers. 

We will ALWAYS back the blue. 🇺🇸

We owe illegal immigrants nothing.

We owe our veterans everything.

The South Carolina Supreme Court just reminded us of something we already knew. Our justice system is broken.

The Alex Murdaugh trial showed the entire country what many of us have known for years: power protects itself, connections matter, justice is not always blind, and the good ole boy system runs deep.

We refuse to accept this as normal. We refuse to look away.

Real judicial reform in South Carolina is long overdue. This is not it.

American families are stretched thin. Washington needs to stop making it worse.

Our American Family Cost-of-Living Relief Act ends the years of Washington quietly implementing regulations raising the cost of groceries, rent, utilities, and healthcare without ever being held accountable for it

With this bill, before any federal agency can pass a new rule, they have to show their work. If your regulation is going to cost American families more money, you have to say so publicly. And if the cost

Our office sat down with the Charleston RiverDogs' President and Owner. The RiverDogs are a cornerstone of the Lowcountry community, driving tourism, boosting the local economy, and bringing Charleston together.

They are more than just a baseball team. They're an economic driver for the Lowcountry, supplying jobs and giving Charleston families a place to make memories.

Wishing them the best of luck the rest of the season. Let's go RiverDogs!

South Carolina STRONG.

I'm calling upon Governor @henrymcmaster to convene a special session immediately following the South Carolina Senate’s adjournment at 5:00 p.m. Thursday.  

The General Assembly has failed to pass a budget, making a special session a requirement rather than a suggestion, however, the only question is whether the Governor will act swiftly to ensure our Congressional maps are drawn constitutionally, or if he will delay until after the June primary to make that goal impossible, and defy President

We called it back in October. Socialism does not work in America.

Zohran Mamdani is running New York City into the ground. He's already said they have no money and is asking for a bailout. It's been 4 months.

New York City deserves better.

Video

This is the same Chuck Schumer blocking the SAVE America act and relying on illegal immigrants to keep him in office.

PASS THE SAVE AMERICA ACT. STOP THE FRAUD.

Right, @SenSchumer?
